title: Finish the worker/Guide platform before broad product scaling

rail_a_platform.name: CONTROL_PLANE_COMPLETION
rail_a_platform.objective: Make one worker capable of taking a substantial product objective from packet/claim through implementation, verification, publication, durable return, then autonomously reallocating to useful work in another project.

rail_b_product.name: REAL_PROJECT_PRODUCTION
rail_b_product.objective: Use the graduated worker system to advance real Prometeo projects at high parallelism.
rail_b_product.rule: Do not use broad real-project scaling to debug basic worker orchestration. Resume broad scaling after the graduation gate passes.

graduation_principle: Scale only after a small number of workers can demonstrably do a large amount of correct useful work each. Throughput should come from parallelism × depth, not parallelism compensating for shallow workers.

phase_plan.goal: Implement LAUNCH-PACKET-V1 so repeated identical human prompts self-assign unique compatible slots and load long compiled context without human numbering/routing.
phase_plan.exit_gate: One synthetic packet with >=3 slots can be claimed 3/3 by distinct fresh workers with exact slot accounting and no duplicate owner.

phase_plan.goal: Run the same complete synthetic product benchmark independently in three isolated slots to test whether a single worker can finish a real page end-to-end.
phase_plan.exit_gate: 3/3 workers satisfy every hard gate; no human routing, no manual result transport, no worker-specific prompt edits.

phase_plan.goal: Each benchmark worker, after completing its primary page, must autonomously take one bounded task from a different synthetic project/lane and produce durable evidence.
phase_plan.exit_gate: 3/3 primary-complete workers successfully reallocate once without a new human instruction.

phase_plan.goal: Freeze a known-good worker baseline, keep regression tests binding, then resume real-project scale using packet-sized compatible demand.
phase_plan.exit_gate: Graduation receipt marks PASS and Guide removes platform scale hold.

benchmark.purpose: A neutral synthetic product with enough UI, state, audio and publication surface to reveal whether a worker really completes a project rather than only producing commits or control-plane receipts.
benchmark.isolation: Each slot writes to its own route and files; workers do not edit each other's CAT-LAB output.

product_spec.title: Cat Lab
constraints: Static HTML/CSS/JS; no paid API and no external dependency required for core behavior.
Two-color visual system; no generic dashboard/card wall.
Usable with touch, mouse and keyboard.
required_features: Four chapter sections with a left chapter rail and push-scroll behavior: current chapter number remains pinned until the incoming divider physically pushes it.
Text-to-speech reader for chapter text using browser speech synthesis: play/pause, previous/next chapter, rate control and visible current-chapter state.
Cat Radio ambient control implemented locally with Web Audio or another bundled/local mechanism; play/stop and volume, with no copyrighted external music dependency.
One lightweight notes field persisted in localStorage and restored after reload.
Two selectable palettes with state persistence.
Exact return/resume behavior after reload for selected chapter, TTS rate, palette and notes where browser APIs permit.
Keyboard and touch interactions must not steal focus from text input.
Visible offline/error-safe behavior when speech synthesis or audio is unavailable.
required_evidence: browser smoke test or explicit durable capability boundary
benchmark receipt mapping every required feature to evidence
forbidden_shortcuts: closing after implementation without publication/evidence when those steps are executable

benchmark.pass_rule: Graduation PASS requires 3/3 independent workers to satisfy every hard gate. A failed worker produces one bounded systemic repair opportunity; do not create an open-ended experiment ladder.
benchmark.human_acceptance: Human visual/taste review is informative but separate from machine graduation. Machine PASS never claims final Human Acceptance of aesthetics.

scale_hold.reason: Finish platform mechanics and the end-to-end worker graduation benchmark before using large cohorts on real projects.
exceptions: small implementation/verification workers explicitly needed to build or test P1-P3

success_definition: After PASS, a normal worker can arrive with one common prompt, self-identify, self-assign one compatible slot, ingest exact long context, finish a substantial product objective, verify/publish/return it, then continue onto useful work elsewhere without the human acting as router or memory.
